_comment: Samira run-lock + per-surface watermarks. Semantics live in the runbook, PART 0 (.claude/routines/samira-atlas-executor.md). Committed to main at run start (lock) and run end (watermarks + completion). Slack watermarks are message ts strings; gmail_after_epoch is Unix seconds; times are ISO-8601 with offset. A null watermark means 'never recorded — fall back to that PART's legacy cutoff once, then record' (for D0BBVV54L5R and C0BV5BRNH5Z the legacy cutoff is the 2026-09-06 wiring-test timestamp). Every slack_channels watermark MUST be a JSON string: the last-read message ts for that surface, or, for a surface quiet this scan, the scan-time epoch seconds as a string. Never store a bare JSON number. Watermarks must never postdate lock.run_completed — they are stamped before the lock closes (PART 0). 2026-09 RESTRUCTURE: swept surfaces are Convo 1 (D0BHPKMDNEP), Convo 2 (D0BBVV54L5R, self-DM), and #fixes (C0BV5BRNH5Z); card_threads (keyed '<channel_id>:<parent_ts>') supersedes decisions_threads, which is FROZEN as the migration worklist — the migration runbook drains it and then deletes it along with the retired timeline-channel watermarks (kept until migration step 0's final legacy sweep). capture_dm is legacy; delete with the same cleanup.
